    About Lucas

    ABOUT LUCAS

    Lucas is an internationally trusted and recognised brand, with strong, robust and well-engineered quality products. Lucas parts are distributed in world markets by specialist partners.

    Lucas bulbs are engineered to Original Equipment standards for high visibility and precise, reliable light. From headlamp halogen and HID xenon to LED upgrades and signal bulbs, find the bulb by Lucas number, fitment or cross-reference, then check voltage, wattage and base before you order.

    Range codes

    READING THE RANGE CODES

    Each Lucas bulb carries a range code after its fitment. For example, H4 SW is an H4 bulb in the Super White range.

    STD
    Standard
    HL
    High Light
    LL
    Long Life
    VF
    Vibration Free
    SF
    Super Fleet
    SW
    Super White
    SWP
    Super White Plus
    YE
    Yellow
    SVP
    Super Vision Plus
    SUVP
    Super Ultra Vision Plus
    SUR
    Super Rally
    HLP
    High Performance
    HW
    High Wattage

    HID xenon colour codes

    STD
    Standard white, 4300K
    WH
    Intense white, 5000K
    RW
    Cool white, 6000K
    BW
    Blue white, 8000K

    On each product card

    Every card shows the Lucas number, fitment and range, then voltage, wattage, base and colour temperature where it applies. Osram, Philips and Hella references are listed for cross-checking.

    4OUR RANGE GOES FURTHER.
    Packaging

    LUCAS PACKAGING

    Every bulb ships in the Lucas green carton. The label shows the Lucas number, voltage, wattage and base, so the right bulb is easy to find on the shelf.
